description: This file defines the SplashScreen activity for an Android app, which displays a splash screen for 4 seconds before navigating to the HomeActivity.

classes.name: SplashScreen
classes.description: An Android activity that displays a splash screen for 4 seconds before launching the HomeActivity.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the splash screen activity, sets up the layout, removes the status bar, and starts the splash delay.

methods.name: splashScreen
methods.description: Handles the delay for the splash screen and transitions to the HomeActivity after 4 seconds.
